verdict.rationale: The SDK itself is documented as provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI's Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs. Docs describe choosing providers per run or per agent, mixing models across agents, and setting a default model through the `OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable, so the model can change without rewriting agent logic. One caveat: OpenAI-hosted tools are tied to OpenAIResponsesModel, and the docs point to feature differences between providers. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how a non-OpenAI provider is configured, independent or hands-on evidence of a provider swap working, and clarity on which features degrade when leaving OpenAI models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.
Select providers per run or per agent and review feature differences
if you want to consistently use a specific model for all agents that do not set a custom model, set the `OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable before running your agents.
